label: sparse, diffuse feature (weak: copying l->p; k-initial sequences near DEL)
explanation: Very sparse (0.0135% of steps) and weak (max 0.21), spread over all phases with no dominant variable. Never fires at t=0..2. Modest enrichments: input l or p (10x/6x lift), output p/k/t/q, first token k (8.6x), and the last 1-2 steps before/at <DEL> (to_go<=1). The top activations are mostly in k-initial sequences at t=7-8 (end of original phase or <DEL>), and the most precise single slice is the copy step where the input is l and the output is p (an l-p bigram being reproduced), but that covers only ~14% of the activation mass at 4% precision. Conjunctions of first token, position and neighboring tokens all stayed below F1 0.07; no coherent description was found.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: l, p, 1, t, o, q; least: z, d, e, c) and the token being output, by phase (delimiter step: k, l, t, a; copy phase: p, t, q, a; input phase: ); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=9 & t=8, t=7.
